anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, likely used to format this dataset; it does not describe the sham neurofeedback VR EEG data.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 32-channel Compumedics NeuroScan SynAmps RT amplifier and Ag/AgCl passive electrodes on an elastic cap following the extended 10-20 system. Stimuli were delivered through a VR headset developed in Unity3D and synchronized with event markers. Each feedback condition consisted of four blocks of about 2 minutes, and the resting-state condition alternated eyes open and eyes closed (1.5 min each). Original .cnt files were converted to BIDS with MNE-BIDS.
